title: Tomato
fertilizerSchedule: Basal dressing: 20t FYM/ha, Split N into 3-4 doses, P & K in basal dressing
preventionTips: Use resistant varieties, proper drainage, crop rotation, remove affected leaves, spray neem oil for pests
harvesting: Pick fruits when fully ripe, 3-4 weeks after flowering
description: Tomato is a warm-season crop grown widely across India. It requires fertile soil and regular watering.

title: Wheat
fertilizerSchedule: N: 60kg at sowing, 60kg at tillering; P & K: full at sowing
preventionTips: Select disease-free seeds, rotate crops, proper field sanitation, use approved fungicides
harvesting: When crop turns golden brown, typically 4-5 weeks after flowering
description: Wheat is the primary cereal crop of India, preferred in cooler months.

title: Rice
fertilizerSchedule: N: 1/3 at transplanting, 1/3 at panicle initiation, 1/3 at heading
preventionTips: Use resistant varieties, proper water management, IPM practices, spray carbofuran for pests
harvesting: When grains turn golden, 25-30 days after flowering
description: Rice is the staple crop of India, requiring ample water supply and warm climate.

title: Potato
fertilizerSchedule: FYM: 20t/ha, Full P & K at sowing, N: 50% at sowing, 50% at earthing up
preventionTips: Use certified seeds, crop rotation, remove infected plants, copper fungicide spray
harvesting: When leaves turn yellow and die, typically 75-90 days after planting
description: Potato is a high-value crop requiring well-drained, fertile soil and moderate temperatures.

title: Maize
fertilizerSchedule: N: 30kg at sowing, 30kg at 30 DAS, 30kg at 60 DAS; P & K at sowing
preventionTips: Use quality seeds, timely sowing, intercropping with pulses, spray Bt-cotton for borers
harvesting: When kernels become hard, milk stage should be over
description: Maize is a versatile crop used for food, feed, and industrial purposes.
